```yaml
name: Bump Personal Server After Release

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  bump-personal-server:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout hushline
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}

      - name: Get release version
        id: get_version
        run: |
          echo "version=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout personal server
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: scidsg/hushline-personal-server
          path: hushline-personal-server
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}

      - name: Update control file
        run: |
          cd hushline-personal-server
          sed -i "s/^Version: .*/Version: ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}/" DEBIAN/control

      - name: Update docker-compose.yaml
        run: |
          cd hushline-personal-server
          sed -i "s/image: scidsg\/hushline:.*/image: scidsg\/hushline:${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}/" var/lib/hushline/docker-compose.yaml

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v6
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.PERSONAL_SERVER_VERSION_BUMP }}
          path: hushline-personal-server
          commit-message: "Bump personal server to v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "Bump personal server to v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          body: "Automated bump from hushline release v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          branch: bump-personal-server-v${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}
          base: main
          delete-branch: true

      - name: Validate workflow
        run: |
          make lint
          make test
          make workflow-security-checks
```
